title: Moss and the Mat
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 4 — Phase 4: Two-syllable words: longer words with two syllables (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 70-sound stage (st, sw, tr just added).

pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog noticing a flat woven mat lying on the grass.

pages.text: Moss can drop the mat down.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog dropping the flat mat down onto a bare patch of ground.
Moss the hedgehog stumbling as his foot catches the edge of the mat.
Moss the hedgehog sprawled flat on top of the mat after slipping.
Moss the hedgehog sitting on the mat looking glum.

pages.text: Nell will come to help Moss.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying over towards Moss, who is still sitting on the mat.

pages.text: Nell and Moss lift the mat up.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Moss the hedgehog lifting the edge of the mat up together.

pages.text: Moss and Nell set the mat flat.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee smoothing the mat out flat on the ground.

pages.text: Moss and Nell rest on the best mat.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting together on the neatly flattened mat.
